[01 / COURSE]{.portfolio-tags}

### Wireless Communication Fundamentals

The main stages of digital signal transmission and reception: coding, modulation, filtering, OFDM and communication quality assessment. Practical work covers communication system simulation in MATLAB or Octave.

<div class="course-bottom"><span>Duration<strong>2 months</strong></span><a href="https://engineers.tusur.ru/courses/osnovy-besprovodnoi-sviazi">Course at TUSUR ↗</a></div>

:::

[02 / COURSE]{.portfolio-tags}

### Multiple Access Technologies

Radio resource sharing and simulation of systems using different multiple access methods. Topics include FDMA, TDMA, CDMA, SDMA, OFDMA, PD-NOMA and SCMA.

<div class="course-bottom"><span>Duration<strong>2 months</strong></span><a href="https://engineers.tusur.ru/courses/tekhnologii-mnozhestvennogo-dostupa">Course at TUSUR ↗</a></div>

:::

[03 / COURSE]{.portfolio-tags}

### Error-Correcting Coding

Error detection and correction in digital communication systems. Topics include CRC, convolutional codes, Viterbi decoding, turbo codes, Hamming codes, LDPC and polar codes.

<div class="course-bottom"><span>Duration<strong>2 months</strong></span><a href="https://engineers.tusur.ru/courses/pomekhoustoichivoe-kodirovanie">Course at TUSUR ↗</a></div>

:::
